subject: Brightline is now part of Pinnacle Workplace Solutions - payment instructions
text:
Dear Brightline customer,

We are excited to share that Brightline Office Supply Inc. has been acquired by Pinnacle Workplace Solutions, and the integration of our two companies is now underway. You will continue to work with the same sales team and receive the same products and pricing.

What changes for you:

1. Beginning with invoices dated December 1, 2026, invoices will be issued by Pinnacle Workplace Solutions, Inc.
2. All payments, including payments on open Brightline invoices, should be remitted to Pinnacle's account:

   Pinnacle Workplace Solutions, Inc.
   JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.
   ABA 021000021
   Account 3349920175

3. A new W-9 for Pinnacle is attached. Please update your vendor records.

What does not change: your customer account number, your sales rep, your delivery schedule.

Thank you for your loyalty. Questions can be directed to transition@pinnacleworkplace.com.

Pinnacle Workplace Solutions
Customer Transition Team
label: change_request
note: Acquisition notice from the acquirer's domain. Routing matches the on-file bank (same 021000021) but the account and payee are new, so a routing-only comparison would miss it.
